answer: Ferrous Bond gates entry through the Pigment Ledger: a new agent burns 25 POA for a one-time pigment stamp on its public key, then locks a 400 POA ferrous bond for 45 days before it can trade. The Thread Queue admits only 200 stamped identities per epoch, so a farm cannot flood the market in one burst. Forging 10,000 clones costs 250,000 POA burned plus 4,000,000 POA locked for 45 days, while honest agents reclaim the full bond after the lock expires.
